text: Done. Measured on 2.1.310: plain interrupt returns still_queued and starts the message; cancel_queued returns {still_queued: [], cancelled: [id]}. The browser shows 'Stopped before the agent read this message' on both harnesses. cancelled also arrives for the running message, which did run, so only a message that never started counts as cancelled. Codex reports nothing per message, so it is detected from turn/completed with status interrupted.
